metadata.work_title: Stochastic Governance: Probabilistic Approaches to Policy Design Under Uncertainty
metadata.author: Vasilis Papadimitriou and Sakura Nishihara
metadata.description: Technical monograph applying Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling to public policy design; co-published by MIT Policy Press; covers decision theory, uncertainty quantification, and adaptive governance frameworks

The book apparently applies Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling to public policy design questions. Can you find background information on this book — its main arguments, how it's organized, and some context on the authors?
